Source and measurement details
  • The new text measures about 159 px inside a 172 px details column in this reconstruction, with 16 px of added vertical space. These are illustration measurements, not browser measurements.
  • The supplied screenshot provides the sponsored label, SNAP badge, delivery text, pickup text and offer. They are reproduced only as screenshot snapshots.
  • Walmart’s public category corroborates the Quantum title, $1.98 price, five-star rating and 104 reviews. Its linked single-bar product page returned 404 when checked.
  • The source listing displays an eight-pack box image for a single 1.69 oz item. The reconstruction preserves that source mismatch; the photo is an unchanged public asset.
  • 10 g protein is manufacturer-supported. Calories are unverified for this exact item and are deliberately omitted. The $1.17/oz figure is calculated from $1.98 divided by 1.69 oz.
